competency_fulfillment.rationale: Both halves of the intended work are here: naming the fraction a shaded region shows, and acting on a shape via 'Shade 1/4 of the shape.', which is the illustrating side of the competency.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The split between the two fractions is lopsided -- a half is the subject of six of the eight samples while a quarter is the subject of two, and all three of the higher seeds return to halves, so quarters of a whole are barely exercised.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The option lists offer 2/1 and 3/2, notations for quantities greater than one whole that a Grade 1 pupil has no schema for. They cannot be reasoned about, only discarded, which turns the identification into elimination rather than fraction reading.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Six samples repeat one identification stem word for word and the remaining two are shading tasks; no item presents the same idea through a differently partitioned shape description or a real object divided into parts.

competency_alignment.rationale: With only two target fractions available, the later seeds simply reproduce the half items already seen at seeds 42 and 43 instead of pressing toward the harder discrimination between a half and a quarter.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Keys are confined to 1/2 and 1/4, exactly the two fractions the competency names, with no denominator beyond four appearing as an answer.
